title: CraftStats
description:
CraftStats is a universal in-game stat editor for Minecraft that lets you inspect and modify the properties of any
  mob, block, item, or player.
body:
!![Player Stats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b443561e8272f5d29633551913fd2471fa61734.png)CraftStats gives you a full in-game editor to customize the stats of any mob, block, item, or player — no config
  files, no restarts, no commands to memorize.

  ---
  What It Does

  Open the editor from the pause menu and pick anything from the searchable browser on the left. Change its stats on the
  right, hit Apply, and the changes take effect immediately in the live world.

  Mobs — health, damage, armor, speed, size, immunities, AI behavior, XP drops, and more.

  Blocks — hardness, blast resistance, slipperiness, light level, XP dropped, collision, climbability, piston reaction,
  and step-on effects like damage, speed boosts, levitation, and potion effects. You can also make any block fall like
  sand or gravel with the Can Fall toggle.

  Items — attack damage, attack speed, durability, stack size, mining speed, food properties, and flags like fireproof,
  unbreakable, and throwable.

  Players — health, damage, speed, gravity, reach, armor, fly speed, jump force, permanent potion effects, fall damage,
  hunger drain, god mode, keep inventory, and much more.

  [Wand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ed7aba9ac5f4230a5d579eabede4dc9145644eb.png)![Stats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c620bf4997e1e97eb33e12841f85e61789bcb7a.png)![Full Stats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f41c916a6a9e497973e248284b77c728ff078c2.png)
![Wand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ed7aba9ac5f4230a5d579eabede4dc9145644eb.png)
  ---
  Features

  - Live editing — changes apply instantly, no reload needed
  - Presets — save and load stat profiles to reuse across entries
  - Propagate — apply the same stats to many entries at once
  - Randomize — randomize stats within bounds you set
  - Copy / Paste — share stat profiles as JSON via clipboard
  - From Block — extract vanilla block properties as a starting point
  - CraftWand — right-click any mob or block in the world to open the editor pre-selected on it
  - Multiplayer ready — works on dedicated servers; requires OP level 2 or creative mode
  - Persistent — stats are saved per world and restored on every restart

  ---
  Requirements

  Fabric: Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Architectury API, Cloth Config, (ModMenu optional)
  NeoForge: NeoForge 21.1.172+, Architectury API, Cloth Config

  ---
  Minecraft 1.21.1 — Fabric & NeoForge
